steps.title: Analyze Existing Design
steps.description: Inspect Hello App's legacy layout to identify visual areas in need of visual upgrades.

steps.title: Establish Visual Brand Identity
steps.description: Formulate a modern vibrant pastel palette (deep indigos, violets, slate grays, and soft rose highlights) aligned with the standard Material Light theme.

steps.title: Create Sparkles Vector Icon
steps.description: Implement standard vector paths in ic_sparkles.xml to serve as a modern header illustration.

steps.title: Design Modern Background Gradient
steps.description: Generate bg_gradient.xml to render a soft modern three-color linear gradient on the root screen background.

steps.title: Design Card Overlay Drawable
steps.description: Build card_background.xml with deep 24dp rounded corners and subtle slate borders to emulate floating Material surface aesthetics.

steps.title: Design Styled Pill Input Field
steps.description: Develop a lightweight input text box drawable (input_background.xml) with thin sleek borders and slate backgrounds.

steps.title: Design Premium Gradient Action Button
steps.description: Construct button_modern.xml, a gorgeous modern gradient pill selector with custom press states for instant haptic response.

steps.title: Construct Modern Scrollable Layout
steps.description: Rewrite activity_main.xml structure, wrapping components in a ScrollView with robust card layouts, interactive chips, and clear typography alignment.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Vibe Selector
steps.description: Add dynamic programmatic UI state management in MainActivity.java to style tone selection chips with real-time border and color shifts.

steps.title: Introduce Interactive Micro-Animations
steps.description: Integrate Java 8 compliant ViewPropertyAnimator pipelines to animate the sparkles logo scaling and content fades on tactile tap.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Wisdom Cycle
steps.description: Incorporate custom inspirational quote engines allowing the user to browse curated thoughts through responsive fade transitions.

steps.title: Clean Up Dependencies in Build Configuration
steps.description: Strip unused dependencies from app/build.gradle to guarantee error-free compilation with targetSdkVersion 34.

steps.title: Verify Standard Namespace Integrity
steps.description: Double check standard layout tags and AndroidManifest namespaces to ensure full compatibility with modern build pipelines.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Compile, build and assemble Hello App using Gradle commands.
